SELECT p.name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount FROM companyx.products p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND registered_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT T1.name FROM companyx.departments AS T1 JOIN companyx.employees AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.dept_id GROUP BY T1.id ORDER BY AVG(T2.salary) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(s.amount) FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id WHERE c.region = '부산' AND s.quarter LIKE '2025-%'
SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM companyx.sales WHERE region = '대전' AND quarter LIKE '2025-%' AND category IN ('security', 'cloud') GROUP BY category
SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D1'
SELECT name, version, release_date FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'

SELECT T1.title, T1.created_at, T2.name FROM companyx.support_tickets AS T1 JOIN companyx.clients AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.id WHERE T1.priority = 'critical' AND T1.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')
SELECT T1.created_at, T1.resolved_at FROM companyx.support_tickets AS T1 INNER JOIN companyx.clients AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Client-X' AND T1.title LIKE '%스테이징 환경 장애%'

SELECT T1.title, (T1.resolved_at - T1.created_at) AS resolution_time FROM companyx.support_tickets AS T1 WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.created_at) = 2025 AND T1.status = 'resolved' ORDER BY (T1.resolved_at - T1.created_at) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.name, T2.end_date FROM companyx.clients AS T1 INNER JOIN companyx.contracts AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.client_id WHERE T2.status = 'active' AND T2.end_date = '2026-10-01'

SELECT T3.name, T1.amount, T1.start_date, T1.end_date FROM companyx.contracts AS T1 INNER JOIN companyx.clients AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.id INNER JOIN companyx.products AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.id WHERE T2.name = 'Client-B' AND T1.contract_type = 'subscription'
SELECT p.budget, p.start_date FROM companyx.projects AS p JOIN companyx.clients AS c ON p.client_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'Client-E' AND p.name LIKE '%로그 분석 시스템%'
SELECT T1.name FROM companyx.projects AS T1 WHERE T1.status = 'on_hold' AND T1.end_date IS NULL
SELECT T1.name, T1.region FROM companyx.clients AS T1 WHERE T1.industry = '의료/바이오'
SELECT * FROM companyx.clients ORDER BY registered_at ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.sale_date, T1.amount FROM companyx.sales AS T1 INNER JOIN companyx.products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Product-S2' AND T1.quarter = '2025-Q1'
